Name: (CP) Transmute (Jelly)
Author: Saah
Description:
[size=5]Description
[/size]This mod was requested in the [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas]mod-ideas repo[/url].
[quote]I noticed that I'm accumulating a lot more river jellies rather than the other two types and thought it would be nice to have a mod that can create a crafting recipe or a machine that converts the jellies. It cold work that sea jellies can be converted into river jellies, river jellies into cave jellies and cave jellies in to sea jellies. But of course if there is a better/preferred way to do this then it doesn't matter to me. Thanks in advance![/quote]
I just did it quickly, so there are no requirements to unlock the crafting recipes, they're unlocked by default. As with every crafting recipe, all three are needed to unlock the Craft Master achievement.

To try and preserve game balance, you need two jellies of one type to convert into the other. Following the request, jelly types are specific, so you need 2 Cave Jellies to make one River Jelly, two River Jellies to make one Sea Jelly, and two Sea Jellies to make one Cave Jelly.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
Should be compatible with anything.
All three recipes show up in the Consumables tab in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url]. It's a very smart mod.

[size=5]Feedback
[/size]Report bugs in the Bugs tab, not in Posts. I don't think I'll take any requests regarding this mod since I don't play using it, but you can try.

[size=5]Permissions[/size]
You're not allowed to make money using this mod's code. Other than that, you can do whatever you want. If you publish a mod using this one's code, send it in Posts since other people might want to see it too.

Manifest.Name: Transmute (Jelly)
Manifest.Description: Adds crafting recipes to transmute jelly between types
